dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 30, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Power Surge: Home Runs Abound as Winners Take Center Stage**

In a day filled with explosive offense, the Chicago White Sox dominated the Detroit Tigers 7-1, led by Edgar Quero's 2-hit, 2-RBI performance that included a home run. Andrew Benintendi added to the White Sox's power surge with his 4th home run of the season. On the mound, Grant Taylor impressed with 4 strikeouts in 2 innings of work.

In other action, the Washington Nationals routed the San Diego Padres 9-4 behind Manny Machado's 2-hit, 2-RBI effort, which included a home run. Meanwhile, the Los Angeles Angels crushed the Tampa Bay Rays 14-3, with Wade Meckler's 2-hit, 4-RBI performance leading the charge.

Ronald Acuña Jr. continued his hot streak, hitting 2 home runs to power the Atlanta Braves to a 5-2 win over the Cincinnati Reds. The Boston Red Sox also notched a convincing 9-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, thanks in part to Jarren Duran's 2-hit, 3-RBI performance that included a home run.
